Mokama ke vidhayak anant sinh ki beti shivangi sinh ki shadi 25 navanbar ko hai. is bhavy shadi samaroh ki taiyariyan bare paimane par chal rahi thin, lekin bhari barish ne vyavasthaon men khalal dal diya tha. ab mausam saph hone ke bad ek bar phir kharab huee chijon ko durust karne men anant sinh aur unke samarthak jut gae hain.
20 bighe ka hors resing traik kharab, helipaid banane ka kam tej
